name: Senna Tower
developer: FG Empreendimentos (with Senna Brands and Grupo Havan)
area: Barra Sul, Balneario Camboriu, Santa Catarina
permit_number: Incorporacao registered R-5, matricula 67.763, 2o Registro de Imoveis de Balneario Camboriu/SC
docs_listed: registro de incorporacao R-5 matricula 67.763 (site footer and brochure)
unit mix: 204 apartments, 18 suspended mansions, duplex and triplex penthouses
amenity and engineering descriptions (tuned mass damper, LEED Platinum target)
developer track record: 60+ projects, about 5,500 units
agent page: prices from BRL 32M, completion estimate 2033-2035
note: Supertall residential tower by FG Empreendimentos with incorporacao registered as R-5 of matricula 67.763 at the 2nd property registry of Balneario Camboriu; 228 units of 300 to 903 m2 marketed from about BRL 32M. No handover date or progress figure is published by the developer (checked 31 Oct 2026).

seed.title: freehold
seed.developer_delivered: FG Empreendimentos states 40+ years, more than 60 large projects delivered and about 5,500 units (sennatower.com); One Tower built with Havan

evidence.permit: sennatower.com and the 2025 sales book state 'Incorporacao registrada no R-5 da matricula 67.763, do 2o Registro de Imoveis de Balneario Camboriu/SC'. Trade press (Resumo Imobiliario, Sep 2026) repeats it from the site; no registry certificate opened.
evidence.escrow: No patrimonio de afetacao or escrow arrangement stated on the developer site or agent page.
evidence.progress: No % published. Resumo Imobiliario cites a Balneario Camboriu city hall note of 27 Mar 2026 that included a visit to the Senna Tower construction site; agent page says groundbreaking in H2 2025.
evidence.plans: Unit descriptions with sizes only; no floor plan drawings found on the official site or agent page.
evidence.record: Developer states 60+ megaprojects and about 5,500 units delivered; One Tower (with Havan) named.
evidence.returns: No guaranteed rental or yield language on official site or agent page.

claims.claim: Incorporacao registered as R-5 of matricula 67.763 at 2o RI Balneario Camboriu
Site has active construction (city hall included site visit, Mar 2026)
Approx BRL 3 billion investment by FG and Havan
EIV and environmental installation licence approved (per 2024 release)
Height over 500 m; world's tallest residential tower
Completion 2033-2035 (agent estimate); no date on official site
Foreigners can own on the same terms as Brazilians (CPF needed)

facts.foreign_ownership: Freehold; foreigners buy directly with a CPF tax number (agent page)
facts.permit_authority: Cartorio de Registro de Imoveis (incorporacao, Lei 4.591/1964); Prefeitura de Balneario Camboriu (alvara)

positives: Incorporacao registration number and registry office published on every page, as Brazilian law requires
Large developer with a stated 60+ project and 5,500 unit track record
